# ===== SITE STRUCTURE =====

Main Pages:
- Homepage: /
- About: /about
- Services Overview: /services
- Service Areas: /service-areas
- Contact: /contact
- Privacy Policy: /privacy-policy
- Terms of Service: /terms-of-service

Service Pages (Clean URLs without /services/ prefix):
All service pages follow pattern: /[service-name]
Example: /building-construction-renovations (not /services/building-construction-renovations)

Service Area Pages:
Pattern: /service-areas/[area-name]
Example: /service-areas/pretoria
